name: Moussaka
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical 4-serving BBC Good Food moussaka-style recipes using similar 500g beef quantities.
Minutes estimated from explicit instruction times (5 min browning + 3-5 min microwave + heating through + grilling) rounded conservatively; no explicit total or per-step prep times given.
Egg is explicitly listed and used.
No wheat, barley, rye or oats; gluten-free classification holds.
Tomato puree and canned tomatoes treated as tomato products without additives that would introduce allergens or gluten.
No fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, soy or sesame ingredients or compounds listed.
instructions:
Heat the grill to high. Brown the beef in a deep ovenproof frying pan over a high heat for 5 mins. Meanwhile, prick the aubergine with a fork, then microwave on High for 3-5 mins until soft. Mix the yogurt, egg and parmesan together, then add a little seasoning.

Stir the tomatoes, purée and potatoes in with the beef with some seasoning and heat through. Smooth the surface of the beef mixture with the back of a spoon, then slice the cooked aubergine and arrange on top. Pour the yogurt mixture over the aubergines, smooth out evenly, then grill until the topping has set and turned golden.

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.assumptions: Minced/ground beef, typical 20% fat content as used in Greek moussaka recipes; raw weight before browning.

ingredients.name: Aubergine
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large aubergine estimated at 400g raw edible flesh; typical size for recipes, including skin which is consumed after microwaving and slicing.

ingredients.name: Greek Yogurt
ingredients.assumptions: Plain Greek yogurt, full-fat strained style common in Greek cuisine; matches the 150g measurement directly.

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large beaten egg estimated at ~50g edible portion (without shell); standard large egg weight used in recipes.

ingredients.name: Parmesan
ingredients.assumptions: Grated parmesan cheese; 3 tablespoons estimated at 15g based on typical packed volume (5g per tbsp).

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.assumptions: Canned chopped tomatoes or passata equivalent; uses the full 400g can weight as drained/edible content in the recipe.

ingredients.name: Tomato Puree
ingredients.assumptions: Tomato puree/paste; 4 tablespoons estimated at 60g (15g per tbsp) based on typical density and recipe usage.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.assumptions: Peeled/boiled potatoes; matches the 350g measurement as prepared weight added to the pan.
